arguments.summary: Command and Control (C2) beaconing was detected from internal host 10.0.8.200 to external IP 10.0.5.14. Further analysis revealed that the true C2 relay node is 10.0.1.10, which was masquerading as a legitimate domain controller. The attacker used the host to proxy C2 traffic via a Cobalt Strike malleable profile over HTTPS (JA3: e7d705a3286e19ea42f587b344ee6865). Traffic was initially misattributed to a decoy IP. The relay node 10.0.1.10 was successfully blocked at the firewall (inbound/outbound), and a full EPP scan on 10.0.8.200 identified a WannaCry variant, though the remediation action was denied due to lack of consensus.
